fullDescription: A warm, playful pastel customer-feedback survey: a soft cream page with sky-blue and coral accents, a centered white survey card overlapping a friendly hero, walking the full range of survey field types: a 5-tile emoji satisfaction radio, multi-select chips, a 0-10 NPS range slider with live Promoter/Passive/Detractor tag, and a counted textarea, topped by a live progress bar.
prompt:
## Resumo
A friendly, pastel customer-feedback survey page ('Superflow') built around THE survey card. A warm cream ground (#fdf9f3) lit by a soft three-blob grain glow, a sky-blue (#38bdf8) + coral (#fb7185) accent pair, and Poppins type. A sticky translucent nav and a centered hero ('Tell us how it really felt', with a hand-drawn coral underline swash) sit above a white survey card that overlaps the hero by a negative top margin. The card has a live gradient progress strip ('3 of 4 answered') and four questions that demonstrate the full range of survey controls: Q1 a 5-tile emoji satisfaction RADIO group (each tile lifts and gets a sky border + filled dot when checked), Q2 a multi-select CHIP grid (coral check-circle + tinted body when checked), Q3 a 0-10 NPS RANGE slider with a big live value, a sky->coral fill track, and a live Promoter/Passive/Detractor pill, and Q4 a focus-glow TEXTAREA with a live 0/280 character count. A footer-action row (Save draft + a navy->burgundy gradient Submit) and a privacy note close the card. Pastel and warm by default; reflows from a 5-up tile row to stacked rows on mobile.

## Estilo Visual
Design a warm, friendly pastel survey UI. Palette: cream page background #fdf9f3; sky blue accent #38bdf8 (soft tint #bae6fd, deep ink #0c4a6e) and coral accent #fb7185 (soft tint #fecdd3, deep ink #9f1239); warm near-black ink #27201a for primary text and muted #6f6457 for secondary text; white #ffffff card and input surfaces. Behind the hero, lay a fixed decorative 'grain' glow built from three radial-gradients (sky rgba(56,189,248,~0.08-0.10) and coral rgba(251,113,133,~0.12) blobs) plus two large blurred floating blob shapes (one coral-soft, one sky-soft) that gently float (translateY 0->-10px, 6s ease-in-out). Typography: Poppins (300,400,500,600,700,800) for everything, tight tracking on the big headline, normal elsewhere. Rounded radii: rounded-2xl/3xl on tiles, chips, slider card and textarea; rounded-4xl (2rem) on the survey card; rounded-full on the nav pills, CTA, progress bar and slider thumb. Shadows: a large diffuse card shadow '0 30px 60px -28px rgba(56,107,138,0.22), 0 8px 20px -12px rgba(251,113,133,0.18)'; a sky pill glow '0 10px 22px -10px rgba(56,189,248,0.55)' on the brand tile; a coral glow '0 14px 28px -12px rgba(251,113,133,0.6)' on the submit button. Micro-interactions (all CSS): selectable radio tiles and multi-select chips translate(-2px) and gain a tinted 2px border, a white->tint gradient fill and a colored drop-glow when their hidden input is :checked; a small inner 'core' dot scales 0->1 with a springy cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); focus-visible draws a soft 3px colored outline; the NPS number plays a 'pop' scale keyframe on change; ::selection is sky-soft. Soft, warm, human, reassuring, lightly playful, accessible.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50) on a translucent cream bg (bg-cream/80 backdrop-blur-xl) with a hairline ink/5 bottom border, 64px tall, inside a max-w-6xl row justify-between. Left = brand: a 36px rounded-2xl tile with a sky->coral gradient (from-sky to-coral) and a sky pill-glow shadow holding a white ph:chat-circle-dots-fill icon, then a 'Superflow' wordmark in Poppins font-700. Center (md+ only) = three muted nav links (Survey, Templates, Insights), font-500, hover:text-ink. Right = a muted 'Sign in' text link (sm+) and a 'Start a survey' pill button (ink-filled, cream text, rounded-full, hover lifts -0.5 and goes black).

### Hero
A relative overflow-hidden section with the .grain radial glow and two absolute blurred floating blob shapes (a coral-soft rounded-[40%] blob upper-right, a sky-soft round blob lower-left, both .float, md+ only). Centered content in a max-w-6xl column: an inline eyebrow pill (rounded-full, white/70, sky/30 border, soft shadow) with a tiny coral dot and 'CUSTOMER FEEDBACK' in 12px font-600 uppercase tracking-[0.18em] sky-ink; a max-w-3xl headline in Poppins font-800 leading-[1.06] (32px up to 6xl) reading 'Tell us how it' then a sky-colored 'really felt' wrapped by an absolute hand-drawn coral underline SVG swash; a max-w-xl muted sub-paragraph in warm proactive voice; and a centered trust row ('~2 min' with a sky ph:clock-fill, a divider, 'Always anonymous' with a coral ph:lock-simple-fill).

### Survey card (the hero component)
A white form card, max-w-3xl, rounded-4xl, hairline ink/[0.06] border, big diffuse 'card' shadow, pulled up over the hero with a negative top margin (-mt-16 / sm:-mt-24, z-10). Top: a live PROGRESS STRIP, a cream/60 row with a hairline bottom border holding a 2px rounded-full track whose base is a sky->coral gradient bar covered by a right-anchored ink/7 'mask' div (its left% = answered/total) and a '3 of 4 answered' counter. Body: a space-y-12 px-9 py-12 stack of four fieldsets, each separated by a faint via-ink/10 gradient hairline rule, every legend a flex with a numbered circle badge (alternating sky/15 sky-ink and coral/15 coral-ink) plus a font-600 question title and a muted helper line. Footer: a cream/60 flex row (stacks reversed on mobile) with a 'Save draft' outline pill (white, 2px ink/10 border) and a chunky 'Submit survey' pill with a navy->burgundy gradient (linear-gradient(105deg,#0c4a6e,#9f1239)), white text + ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, coral glow shadow. Below the card: a centered muted privacy note with a sky-ink 'Privacy' link.

### Q1 - emoji satisfaction radio group
Fieldset Q1 'How satisfied are you with Superflow?' (helper 'Pick the one that fits today.'): a grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-3 of five radio tiles (.opt). Each tile is a label wrapping a visually-hidden radio (position absolute, opacity 0, inset 0) and a .tile span: a 2px ink/[0.08] border, cream/50 fill, rounded-2xl, that is a horizontal row on mobile (emoji + label + dot) and a centered column on sm+. Each holds a big emoji (😞 🙁 😐 🙂 😍), a font-500 label (Very dissatisfied / Dissatisfied / Neutral / Satisfied / Very satisfied) and a 20px ring 'dot' with an inner white 'core'. When the input is :checked the tile gets a sky border, a white->#f0faff gradient, a sky drop-glow and translate-y(-2px); the dot fills sky with a sky ring and the inner core scales 1; the emoji scales up and tilts; hover gives a sky-soft border and -1px lift; focus-visible draws a sky outline. (The 'Satisfied' tile is shown pre-checked.)

### Q2 - multi-select chip grid
Fieldset Q2 'Which parts do you value most?' (helper 'Select all that apply.'): a grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 of six checkbox chips (.chip). Each chip is a label wrapping a hidden checkbox and a .body span: a 2px ink/[0.08] border, cream/50 fill, rounded-2xl flex row with a leading Phosphor icon (ph:hand-tap-fill, ph:lightning-fill, ph:palette-fill, ph:stack-fill, ph:lifebuoy-fill, ph:tag-fill), a font-500 label (Ease of use, Performance, Design, Features, Support, Pricing) and a trailing ph:check-circle-fill 'check' icon. When :checked the body gets a coral border, a white->#fff5f6 gradient, a coral glow and -2px lift; the check icon springs from scale .6/opacity 0 to full; the label turns coral-ink font-600 and the leading icon turns coral; hover gives a coral-soft border. (Performance and Design are shown pre-checked.)

### Q3 - NPS range slider
Fieldset Q3 'How likely are you to recommend us?' (helper 'Drag the dot, 0 to 10.'): a rounded-3xl cream/50 card with a hairline ink/7 border holding a big live value (a 5xl font-800 sky-ink number that .pop-animates on change, with a muted '/ 10'); a custom range input (.nps) min 0 max 10 step 1, a 14px rounded-full track whose fill is a JS-painted linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8 0%, #fb7185 pct%, #e9e0d4 pct%), and a 32px white round thumb with a 5px sky border and a sky drop-glow (grab/grabbing cursor, scales on active); and a row of 'Not likely' (coral ph:thumbs-down) / a live segment pill / 'Very likely' (sky ph:thumbs-up). The pill text + color updates live: 0-6 = coral 'Detractor', 7-8 = muted 'Passive', 9-10 = sky 'Promoter'. (Shown at value 9, Promoter.)

### Q4 - counted textarea
Fieldset Q4 'What could we make better?' (helper 'Be honest, we can take it.'): a rounded-2xl wrapper with a 2px ink/[0.08] border on cream/40 that on focus-within turns sky-border, white bg and gains a soft 4px sky ring (box-shadow rgba(56,189,248,0.12)); inside, a 4-row transparent resize-none textarea (placeholder 'I'd love it if you could…') and a footer row with a 'Every note is read by a human' note (coral ph:heart-fill) and a live '0 / 280' character counter (JS-clamped to 280).

### Footer
A full-width footer with a hairline ink/5 top border on white, max-w-6xl, py-8, a flex row (stacks on mobile) with: the brand (a 28px rounded-xl sky->coral gradient tile + 'Superflow' wordmark), a centered 'Made with care · © 2026 Superflow Labs' line, and a row of three social icon links (ph:twitter-logo-fill, ph:github-logo-fill, ph:envelope-simple-fill) with sky/coral hover colors.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Emoji satisfaction radio tile (.opt)
A label-wrapped custom radio: a visually-hidden <input type=radio> (position absolute, opacity 0, inset 0, cursor pointer) plus a .tile span styled as the control, so the native radio is invisible but accessible. The tile is a 2px ink/[0.08] border, cream/50, rounded-2xl card holding a large emoji, a font-500 text label and a 20px ring 'dot' enclosing a scale-0 white 'core'. Transitions use cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). On input:checked ~ .tile: border sky #38bdf8, background linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f0faff), box-shadow 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(56,189,248,0.55), translateY(-2px); the .dot becomes sky-filled with a 4px sky/18 ring and its .core scales to 1; the .emoji scales 1.12 rotate(-3deg). Hover: sky-soft border + -1px lift. Focus-visible: 3px sky/45 outline offset 2px. Layout flips from a flex-row (mobile) to a centered flex-col (sm+).

### Multi-select chip (.chip)
A label-wrapped custom checkbox: a hidden <input type=checkbox> plus a .body span. The body is a 2px ink/[0.08] border, cream/50, rounded-2xl flex row with a leading Phosphor icon, a flex-1 font-500 label, and a trailing ph:check-circle-fill 'check' that starts scale(.6) opacity 0. On input:checked ~ .body: border coral #fb7185, background linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff5f6), coral glow box-shadow 0 12px 24px -14px rgba(251,113,133,0.6), translateY(-2px); the .check springs to scale 1 opacity 1; the .label turns #9f1239 font-600; the leading icon turns coral. Hover: coral-soft border + -1px lift. Focus-visible: 3px coral/40 outline. Used as a select-all-that-apply grid.

### Custom NPS range slider (input[type=range].nps)
A styled native range: appearance-none, full width, 14px tall, rounded-full, base track #e9e0d4. The fill is painted in JS as background:linear-gradient(90deg,#38bdf8 0%, #fb7185 {pct}%, #e9e0d4 {pct}%) where pct = value/10*100. Thumb (::-webkit-slider-thumb and ::-moz-range-thumb): a 32px white round thumb with a 5px sky #38bdf8 border and box-shadow 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(56,189,248,0.7), cursor grab/grabbing, scale 1.12 on active. A large sky-ink value number above it plays a .pop keyframe (scale .85->1, springy) on every input, and a live segment pill below reads Detractor (0-6, coral) / Passive (7-8, muted) / Promoter (9-10, sky).

### Live progress strip
A thin progress indicator: a 2px (h-2) rounded-full track whose base layer is a full sky->coral gradient bar, covered by an absolutely-positioned right-anchored ink/[0.07] 'mask' div whose left% equals answered/total (transition-all 500ms), so the colored portion grows left-to-right as questions are answered. A shrink-0 '{n} of 4 answered' counter sits beside it. JS recomputes n on every radio/checkbox change and textarea input (textarea counts only when >=10 chars; the NPS always counts).

### Focus-glow textarea
A rounded-2xl wrapper with a 2px ink/[0.08] border on cream/40 that on :focus-within turns its border sky, background white, and gains box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(56,189,248,0.12). Inside: a transparent, resize-none, 4-row textarea with a muted placeholder, plus a footer row carrying a reassuring 'Every note is read by a human' note (coral ph:heart-fill) and a live 'N / 280' counter; JS hard-clamps input to 280 chars.

### Hero underline swash
An inline highlight on a headline word: the word is sky-colored and whitespace-nowrap, with an absolute hand-drawn underline SVG just below it (a single coral #fb7185 path, stroke-width 4, round caps, preserveAspectRatio none so it stretches to the word width), giving the marker-underline look.

### Gradient brand tile
A rounded square tile (36px nav / 28px footer) with a from-sky to-coral diagonal gradient and a sky pill-glow shadow (0 10px 22px -10px rgba(56,189,248,0.55)), centering a white Iconify Phosphor ph:chat-circle-dots-fill icon; used as the Superflow brand mark.

## Notas Especiais
Built on the Tailwind CDN with a tailwind.config extend: custom colors cream #fdf9f3, sky {DEFAULT #38bdf8, soft #bae6fd, ink #0c4a6e}, coral {DEFAULT #fb7185, soft #fecdd3, ink #9f1239}, ink #27201a, muted #6f6457; custom boxShadow card / pill / coral / soft; custom borderRadius 4xl 2rem and 5xl 2.75rem; fontFamily sans = Poppins. Fonts load from Google Fonts (Poppins 300-800); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) via the iconify-icon CDN; the body background is set to #fdf9f3. All form controls are real, accessible native inputs (radio/checkbox/range/textarea) visually replaced via the checked/focus-visible sibling pattern, so keyboard and screen-reader behavior is preserved. The progress strip, the NPS value+fill+segment pill, and the textarea character counter are driven by a small vanilla-JS block (no framework). On a single static frame the hover-lift, the checked springs, the .pop and the floating blobs only fully animate live; the survey is shown pre-filled to demonstrate range (Q1 'Satisfied' checked, Q2 Performance+Design checked, Q3 at 9/Promoter, progress at '3 of 4 answered'). 'Superflow' is an illustrative product/brand placeholder for a generic feedback-survey app.

Thumb (::-webkit-slider-thumb and ::-moz-range-thumb): a 32px white round thumb with a 5px sky #38bdf8 border and box-shadow 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(56,189,248,0.7), cursor grab/grabbing, scale 1.12 on active. A large sky-ink value number above it plays a .pop keyframe (scale .85->1, springy) on every input, and a live segment pill below reads Detractor (0-6, coral) / Passive (7-8, muted) / Promoter (9-10, sky).

A thin progress indicator: a 2px (h-2) rounded-full track whose base layer is a full sky->coral gradient bar, covered by an absolutely-positioned right-anchored ink/[0.07] 'mask' div whose left% equals answered/total (transition-all 500ms), so the colored portion grows left-to-right as questions are answered. A shrink-0 '{n} of 4 answered' counter sits beside it. JS recomputes n on every radio/checkbox change and textarea input (textarea counts only when >=10 chars; the NPS always counts).

A rounded-2xl wrapper with a 2px ink/[0.08] border on cream/40 that on :focus-within turns its border sky, background white, and gains box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(56,189,248,0.12). Inside: a transparent, resize-none, 4-row textarea with a muted placeholder, plus a footer row carrying a reassuring 'Every note is read by a human' note (coral ph:heart-fill) and a live 'N / 280' counter; JS hard-clamps input to 280 chars.

An inline highlight on a headline word: the word is sky-colored and whitespace-nowrap, with an absolute hand-drawn underline SVG just below it (a single coral #fb7185 path, stroke-width 4, round caps, preserveAspectRatio none so it stretches to the word width), giving the marker-underline look.

A rounded square tile (36px nav / 28px footer) with a from-sky to-coral diagonal gradient and a sky pill-glow shadow (0 10px 22px -10px rgba(56,189,248,0.55)), centering a white Iconify Phosphor ph:chat-circle-dots-fill icon; used as the Superflow brand mark.

structured.special_notes: Built on the Tailwind CDN with a tailwind.config extend: custom colors cream #fdf9f3, sky {DEFAULT #38bdf8, soft #bae6fd, ink #0c4a6e}, coral {DEFAULT #fb7185, soft #fecdd3, ink #9f1239}, ink #27201a, muted #6f6457; custom boxShadow card / pill / coral / soft; custom borderRadius 4xl 2rem and 5xl 2.75rem; fontFamily sans = Poppins. Fonts load from Google Fonts (Poppins 300-800); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) via the iconify-icon CDN; the body background is set to #fdf9f3. All form controls are real, accessible native inputs (radio/checkbox/range/textarea) visually replaced via the checked/focus-visible sibling pattern, so keyboard and screen-reader behavior is preserved. The progress strip, the NPS value+fill+segment pill, and the textarea character counter are driven by a small vanilla-JS block (no framework). On a single static frame the hover-lift, the checked springs, the .pop and the floating blobs only fully animate live; the survey is shown pre-filled to demonstrate range (Q1 'Satisfied' checked, Q2 Performance+Design checked, Q3 at 9/Promoter, progress at '3 of 4 answered'). 'Superflow' is an illustrative product/brand placeholder for a generic feedback-survey app.
